jobs.title: Route one call to the cheapest venue
Prove and track Flop compute spend

tools.name: justweight
tools.summary: One price table for every inference venue (Flop, Pearl, Venice, Chutes, each OpenRouter provider, local) in one unit, each price linked to its source.

tools.name: agent-price-feed
tools.summary: Alerts by JSON Feed, RSS, CLI and MCP when those prices move, a cheaper route appears, or Flop lists a model.

tools.name: justweight infer
tools.summary: An MCP tool that routes one call to the cheapest venue meeting your privacy floor, under hard spend caps, and returns chained receipts.

tools.name: agent-spendcap
tools.summary: A budget policy for agents: holds before each call, settlement from real usage, a hash-chained ledger, and a drop-in fetch for OpenAI-compatible APIs.
tools.run: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xbtMelchizedek/agent-spendcap/main/examples/policy.json | npx -y github:xbtMelchizedek/agent-spendcap authorize --policy /dev/stdin --venue openrouter:pearl-research/fp8 --model qwen/qwen3.8-27b --usd 0.004 --privacy no-retention

tools.name: agent-cost-proxy
tools.summary: One command, a local proxy for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes) that records each call's real cost and the cheapest listed price for the same tokens, with optional caps.

tools.name: x402-price-check
tools.summary: Checks an x402 402 quote against justweight list prices and your agent-spendcap budget before an agent pays. Never signs or pays.

tools.name: flop-receipt-root
tools.summary: Proves a Flop compute settlement to an EVM contract without a bridge, and checks one receipt offline.

tools.name: flop-spend
tools.summary: Has an address spent on Flop inference yet? Settled spend per address, re-read on chain, as a CLI, MCP tool and dashboard.
